text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows hypoxemia, mild anemia, leukopenia with lymphopenia, thrombocytopenia, monocytosis, and basophilia. These findings may suggest a bone marrow disorder, acute infection, or systemic inflammatory process. Immediate clinical correlation and further diagnostic workup, including infectious, autoimmune, and hematologic evaluation, are recommended. Other parameters are within normal limits.
